title: Bhāvanā
text: 2. Catunnam bhikkhave satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvanaṃ desissāmi || taṃ suṇātha || || Katamā ca bhikkhave catunnam satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvanā || || 3. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyanupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ [page 183] Saṃyutta-Nikāya. 183 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || || 4 Ayam bhikkhave catunnam satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvanā ti || ||
